dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five primary 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible, characterized by thin, high-intensity (white) perimeters with serrated, irregular edge geometries. The gradient transition is abrupt, shifting from dark exterior pixels to high-intensity border pixels over a narrow 2-4 pixel span.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical solid-white pixel clusters is localized in the lower-left and far-right lateral margins. These blobs exhibit core pixel saturation and lack an internal gradient or central void.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest annuli in the central-right quadrant form a localized quadrilateral. A fifth centroid from a lower-left annulus creates a long-distance obtuse triangle when connected to the two upper-most structures.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a reticulated interlocking effect where adjacent annuli share high-intensity boundary segments, creating a tessellated, honeycomb-like appearance in the mid-body region.
